stories.label: Iran-US nuclear standoff and military buildup
stories.summary: UK blocked US from using British bases for Iran strikes — major transatlantic split. Trump still says 'considering' limited strike. Iran FM says draft deal in 2-3 days. Dual-track escalation and diplomacy. Oil above $72. Hormuz closed. Two carriers deployed. Congressional war powers vote being planned.

stories.label: US Supreme Court strikes down tariffs; Trump invokes new authority
stories.summary: Supreme Court struck down Trump's emergency tariffs 6-3. Trump immediately invoked Section 122 of the 1974 Trade Act to impose 10% global tariff. Constitutional confrontation escalating — new legal authority hasn't been tested in court.

stories.label: Trump pursues Saudi nuclear deal with enrichment path
stories.summary: US negotiating nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia that would allow enrichment — while simultaneously demanding Iran end enrichment. Major proliferation risk for the Middle East.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire fraying after camp strike
stories.summary: Israel struck Ein el-Hilweh, largest Palestinian refugee camp in Lebanon, killing at least 2. Ceasefire zone violated. Hezbollah already rejected disarmament. Escalation risk rising.

stories.label: NASA targets March for Artemis II crewed Moon mission
stories.summary: NASA targeting early March for Artemis II — first crewed mission beyond Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972. Four astronauts will loop around the Moon.

stories.label: DARPA reviving 40,000-year-old microbes from permafrost
stories.summary: DARPA funding extraction and revival of ancient microorganisms from permafrost. Military interest in novel biochemistry — potential antibiotics and biodefense applications.

stories.label: FT exposes $90B Russian oil sanctions evasion network
stories.summary: Financial Times investigation reveals shell company network exporting $90B in sanctioned Russian oil. Shows industrial-scale sanctions evasion.

stories.label: China routing drones to Russia via Thailand
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports China using Thailand as transit point to ship drones to Russia, circumventing sanctions. Drones are the defining weapon of the Ukraine war.

stories.label: China's gallium grip ahead of Trump Beijing visit
stories.summary: China controls ~80% of global gallium/germanium supply. Export control deadline looming as Trump visits Beijing. Semiconductor supply chain at risk.

stories.label: Ethiopia-Tigray-Eritrea tensions as peace deal frays
stories.summary: Pretoria peace deal fraying. Eritrea hasn't withdrawn from northern Ethiopia. Tigray reconstruction stalled. Horn of Africa instability rising.

stories.label: Trump Board of Peace for Gaza and US military base
stories.summary: Board of Peace inaugural meeting held. $7B pledged. Indonesia commits 8,000 troops. US planning 5,000-person base at Rafah.

stories.label: Hamas holds vote for new interim leader
stories.summary: Hamas conducting internal vote to select new interim leader. Significant governance shift amid reconstruction push.

stories.label: China overtakes US as Germany's top trading partner
stories.summary: Germany's trade center of gravity shifted to Beijing. Structural change driven by US tariff disruptions.

stories.label: Cameroon soldiers sentenced for killing 21 civilians
stories.summary: Military tribunal sentenced soldiers for killing 21 civilians. Rare accountability for security forces.

stories.label: US jets escort Russian aircraft from Alaska
stories.summary: Russia probing US air defenses near Alaska while American attention focused on Iran.

stories.label: Personalized mRNA cancer vaccine shows durable immunity
stories.summary: Nature paper: personalized mRNA vaccines produce durable T cell immunity in triple-negative breast cancer.

stories.label: Climate physicists confront the cloud problem
stories.summary: Clouds are the biggest uncertainty in climate models, determining whether warming hits 2C or 4C.

stories.label: China's reverse Great Firewall blocks global data access
stories.summary: Study finds Beijing blocking government websites from outside China — a 'reverse Great Firewall'.

stories.label: Glass data storage holds 2 million books for 10,000 years
stories.summary: Scientists demonstrate glass-based storage lasting 10,000 years.

stories.label: Argentina general strike vs Milei labor reform
stories.summary: Lower house passed Milei's labor reform despite nationwide strike. Bill heads to Senate.

stories.label: US-China aerial standoff over Yellow Sea
stories.summary: China scrambled fighters to confront US F-16s over Yellow Sea. USFK reorienting toward China.

stories.label: Israeli settlers kill Palestinian-American in West Bank
stories.summary: 19-year-old Palestinian-American killed by settlers. Forcing US diplomatic response.

stories.label: Poland exits Ottawa Convention on landmines
stories.summary: First NATO ally to formally withdraw from Ottawa Convention.

stories.label: Europe's energy dependency shift from Russian gas to US LNG
stories.summary: Europe replaced Russian gas dependency with American LNG dependency.

stories.label: Global AI model race and governance
stories.summary: US rejected multilateral AI governance at India summit. India summit closing. AI governance a major geopolitical fault line.

stories.label: Antarctic changes under high emissions and polar science threats
stories.summary: Antarctica faces devastating changes. Trump funding cuts dismantling monitoring infrastructure.

stories.label: Lancet study finds Gaza death toll one-third higher than reported
stories.summary: Peer-reviewed Lancet study finds actual casualties roughly a third higher than official figures.

stories.label: Duterte faces ICC pre-trial over Philippine drug war
stories.summary: Duterte facing first ICC pre-trial hearing over drug war killings.

stories.label: Measles resurgence and vaccine-preventable disease risk
stories.summary: Measles rising as canary for broader vaccine hesitancy. HHS policy shifts compounding threat.

stories.label: DW correspondent arrested in Turkey
stories.summary: Deutsche Welle journalist arrested in Turkey. Pattern of media crackdowns.

stories.label: Oil hits 8-month high on Iran military tensions
stories.summary: Brent topped $72/barrel. Gold surging as safe haven.

stories.label: China CO2 emissions may have peaked
stories.summary: CO2 flat or falling for 21 months. Cheaper renewables displacing coal.

stories.label: Venezuela amnesty law and post-Maduro transition
stories.summary: Amnesty law passed unanimously. Political prisoners being released.

stories.label: African trade bloc probes Meta over WhatsApp chatbot lockout
stories.summary: Comesa opened antitrust probe into Meta for blocking rival AI chatbots from WhatsApp.

stories.label: South Korea Yoon martial law verdict
stories.summary: Yoon sentenced to life. KOSPI hit record 5,800. Appeal expected.

stories.label: Sudan genocide assessment and humanitarian crisis
stories.summary: UN crossed 'hallmarks of genocide' threshold. RSF drone attacks continue.

stories.label: Federal judge blocks Trump mass detention policy
stories.summary: Federal judge vacated mass detention decision using extraordinary language.

stories.label: North Korea ninth Workers' Party congress
stories.summary: Congress ongoing. Kim touting economic achievements.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia Geneva peace talks
stories.summary: Talks stalled. No new round announced. Focus shifted to Iran crisis.

stories.label: Former Prince Andrew arrested over Epstein links
stories.summary: Released after arrest. Epstein estate agreed to $35M settlement. UK may remove from succession.

stories.label: Zuckerberg social media addiction trial
stories.summary: Trial ongoing. No major new development.

stories.label: Ocalan announces PKK dissolution
stories.summary: Reintegration gaining momentum.
